name: Justice Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public justice and criminal-justice data.

entries.title: Eurostat Crime and Criminal Justice Database
entries.description: Eurostat's official statistics on police-recorded offences, persons brought into the criminal justice system, prisoners, and justice personnel across EU member states, collected jointly with UNODC.

coverage.spatial: EU member states (plus some EFTA and candidate countries)

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (Eurostat copyright notice and free re-use of data)
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (page title "Database - Crime and criminal justice - Eurostat"). Eurostat's copyright notice (https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/help/copyright-notice) licenses its content under CC BY 4.0. The joint Eurostat-UNODC collection, mentioned in the description, comes from Eurostat's usual metadata and was not checked here. API and bulk access go through Eurostat's general dissemination services.

entries.title: UNODC Data Portal
entries.description: The UN Office on Drugs and Crime's statistical portal covering intentional homicide, trafficking, prison populations, corruption, and access-to-justice indicators across UN member states.
entries.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200, redirects to data.unodc.org). Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
